issues.display_title: Issue #241: Strip Information Pano tab to a linked-pano viewer
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Description

Follow-up to #238. The Information modal's Pano tab (src/components/editor/information-modal/PanoTab.tsx) still carries the manual load-tour flow: paste a tour link -> load the panorama list -> pick one. That flow is obsolete — panoramas are now assigned by the Add Panorama import tool (#238), which creates the Information record with its pano ref directly.

Strip the tab down to a linked-pano viewer:

  • Show the linked panorama (thumbnail, source tour key) when Information.pano is set
  • Keep View 360 (opens the existing PanoModal) and Unlink (clears Information.pano)
  • Delete the tour-key input, the load/list/picker flow, and its fetchTourPanoramas usage in this tab
  • Empty state: short copy pointing to the Add Panorama tool ("Panoramas are linked by importing a tour in the editor")

Why

Two ways to attach a pano = drift and double maintenance; the picker's per-record manual flow is superseded by the import pipeline. Note: #225's original cleanup line ("remove the Pano tab, retire Information.pano") is obsolete — the implemented design keeps Information.pano as the linkage, so the tab survives as its viewer.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Pano tab shows the linked panorama with thumbnail + View 360 + Unlink
  • No tour-link input or panorama picker remains in the tab
  • Unlink clears Information.pano and the empty state appears
  • fetchTourPanoramas no longer imported by this tab (other callers untouched)
  • Existing records with a linked pano render unchanged elsewhere (markers, PanoModal)

Dependencies

#238 (merged)

RESULT

Stripped the Pano tab to a linked-pano viewer (src/components/editor/information-modal/PanoTab.tsx, 195 -> 64 lines).

What changed:

  • Linked state: card with pano thumbnail, Panorama {id}, source tour key, View 360 (opens the existing PanoModal from src/components/editor/preview/PanoModal.tsx) and Unlink (clears Information.pano, empty state appears)
  • Empty state: "No panorama linked. Panoramas are linked by importing a tour with the Add Panorama tool in the editor."
  • Deleted the tour-key input, load/list/picker flow, and the tab's fetchTourPanoramas/extractTourKey imports — the only remaining caller is src/actions/tours.ts (Add Panorama pipeline), untouched
  • Markers and PanoModal rendering elsewhere unchanged

Typecheck (tsc --noEmit) and eslint clean.

Commit: 327b4c1 (branch feature/241-strip-pano-tab-linked-viewer)

issues.display_title: Issue #246: Preview marker labels: dot centered on object position, clickable like room select
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Description

Preview marker labels (src/components/editor/map-markers/MapObjectMarkers.tsx) had two problems:

  1. Anchor — the whole dot+label button was centered on the object position (translate(-50%,-100%)), so the actual point/room position fell in the gap between the dot and the text.
  2. Not clickable — preview passed a no-op onSelect to MapObjectMarkers, so point/safety labels could not be selected at all (rooms were only selectable via their polygon).

Scope

  • Anchor the leading dot/chip's center exactly on the object position; the name label trails to the right, vertically centered. Applies to all label modes (text dot, icon/logo/photo chip, unlinked chip, far-zoom bare dot) with per-mode offsets, and the declutter boxes follow the new geometry.
  • Clicking a marker label selects its object through the same Selection path as a room polygon click (info card, fly-to, pano button). onSelect carries the marker kind; the selected marker shows the blue ring via selectedIds.

Acceptance Criteria

  • The dot/chip center sits exactly on the point/room/safety position at every zoom, tilt, and rotation
  • The name label renders to the right of the dot, vertically centered
  • Clicking a point/safety/area label selects the object exactly like a room polygon click
  • The selected marker shows the selection ring
  • Editor Map tab markers keep working unchanged

Dependencies

None (follow-up to #238/#200 marker work)

RESULT

Both fixed in branch fix/marker-dot-anchor, merged to development (a9bc466).

Commits:

  • 09b14ab fix(preview): anchor the marker dot on the object position, label to the right — reposition() now shifts each button left by the leading visual's half-width (data-ah: text dot 4px, chips 14px, unlinked 12px, bare dot 5px) and vertically centers it; declutter boxes updated to the same geometry.
  • 214524d feat(preview): marker labels select their object like a room click — onSelect(id, kind) routes into setSelection({ kind, id }) for area/point/safety (same path as polygon/canvas hits); selectedIds wired so the active marker gets its ring. Editor Map tab untouched.

Typecheck + eslint clean.

issues.display_title: Issue #244: Edit Project Info dialog: address autocomplete, marker sync, input-driven pin
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Muhamad Rifky — Developer

Description

Bring the Edit Project Info dialog (src/components/editor/EditFileModal.tsx) to parity with the wizard's Select Location step (#236, #237). The dialog has the same two modes — Location (address) and Lat-Lng (manual) — but today the address field is a plain input, the marker never syncs with the address, and manual mode still lets the map move the pin.

  1. Address autocomplete (both modes) — typing in the address field queries the search API (debounced) and shows suggestions; picking one fills latitude & longitude and moves the pin.

  2. Location mode: marker ↔ address sync — dragging the marker reverse-geocodes the new position and fills the address field; loading spinner in the address input while in flight; stale results dropped on concurrent drags.

  3. Lat-Lng mode: input-driven pin — map click/drag must NOT move or drop the pin; the pin is driven exclusively by the lat/lng inputs. Editing lat or lng repositions the pin and reverse-geocodes (debounced) to show the resolved place. If the pin leaves the viewport, the map auto-refocuses on it.

  4. Modal size — increase the size of the project info edit modal to "Large".

Reference implementation

Reuse everything shipped for the wizard in #236/#237 (branch feature/236-address-autocomplete-select-location, PR #240):

  • Server actions in src/actions/search.ts — GET /search (autocomplete) and GET /places/coordinates (reverse geocode), proxied server-side with X-Search-Token from env. Never call the host from the browser.
  • MapLibreCore already supports autoRefocus and user-move detection (isUserMove) — wire the same props from the dialog.
  • Same debounce + stale-result-guard patterns as StepSelectLocation.tsx / WizardShell.tsx.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Typing an address in the dialog shows autocomplete suggestions (debounced; no request per keystroke)
  • Selecting a suggestion fills lat & lng and moves the pin (both modes)
  • Location mode: dragging the marker reverse-geocodes and fills the address; spinner while loading; stale results dropped
  • Lat-Lng mode: clicking/dragging the map never moves or drops the pin
  • Lat-Lng mode: editing lat or lng immediately repositions the pin; resolved place shown for the coordinates (graceful on API failure)
  • Lat-Lng mode: panning the pin out of the viewport auto-refocuses the map on the pin
  • All search/geodata calls go through the server-side proxy; no token in client bundle or repo
  • Edit Project Info modal uses the "Large" size
  • Save still validates and persists via updateProject exactly as before

Dependencies

#236, #237 — requires src/actions/search.ts and the MapLibreCore autoRefocus/isUserMove support from branch feature/236-address-autocomplete-select-location (PR #240) to be merged into development first.

RESULT

Brought the Edit Project Info dialog (src/components/editor/EditFileModal.tsx) to parity with the wizard's Select Location step, reusing src/actions/search.ts and the MapLibreCore autoRefocus / isUserMove support merged from #240.

Implemented

  • Address autocomplete (both modes) — debounced (350ms) searchAddressAction; suggestion dropdown with outside-click + Esc close; picking a suggestion fills lat/lng, moves the pin, and cancels any in-flight geocode.
  • Location mode — marker ↔ address sync — markerMode="crosshair"; on user-move the pin drag reverse-geocodes (getPlaceByCoordinatesAction), fills the address, shows an input spinner (addressLoading), and drops stale results via a geocodeSeqRef guard.
  • Lat-Lng mode — input-driven pin — markerMode="static"; handleMapMove returns early so map click/drag never moves the pin. Editing lat/lng repositions the pin and debounce (800ms) reverse-geocodes; autoRefocus re-centres the map when the pin leaves the viewport.
  • Modal size — bumped max-w-md → max-w-2xl (Large); map height h-48 → h-64.
  • Save path unchanged — same updateProject validate + persist.

All search/geocode calls go through the server-side proxy; no token in the client bundle. Typecheck + ESLint clean.

Files changed: src/components/editor/EditFileModal.tsx

Commit: 0e9e28e

issues.display_title: Issue #248: Link Information to shapes from the Map tab, like doors/areas
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Description

Shapes (rect / circle / polygon) already carry infoId in the data model: marker anchors render them (src/lib/map/object-markers.ts), unlinkObjectInfo and deleteInformation already clear them, and the sidebar copy promises "Select an area, point, shape, door, or safety annotation, then connect it". But the link flow itself — select the object on the Map tab, then attach an Information record via the InformationSection card — only resolves areas and point/safety annotations (src/components/editor/SelectedFeaturePanel.tsx), so a shape can never be linked in the first place.

Make shapes linkable to Information exactly like the other object kinds:

  • Selecting a shape on the Map tab (marker click / canvas click) shows the SelectedFeaturePanel with the Information link section
  • New store action to set a shape's infoId (mirror of setAreaInfo / setAnnotationInfo)
  • Linked shape markers get the label pill (already handled by MapObjectMarkers once infoId is set)

Acceptance Criteria

  • Clicking a shape (rect/circle/polygon) on the Map tab opens the detail panel with the Information link section
  • Linking attaches infoId to the shape on the active level; the marker pill switches to the linked label
  • Unlink from the panel and from the Information list both clear it (existing unlinkObjectInfo path)
  • Deleting an Information record still clears infoId from shapes (existing behavior, keep green)
  • Areas, points, safety annotations keep working unchanged

Dependencies

None

RESULT

Shapes (rect/circle/polygon) can now be linked to Information from the Map tab.

What changed:

  • src/store/useMapStore.ts + useMapStore.types.ts — new setShapeInfo(shapeId, infoId) action, mirror of setAreaInfo, targets level.shapes on the active level
  • src/components/editor/SelectedFeaturePanel.tsx — resolves a selected shape id and renders the "Shape · {name}" panel with the InformationSection link/unlink card
  • src/store/__tests__/useMapStore-unlink.test.ts — new test covering setShapeInfo link + unlink + dirty flag

Already in place (untouched): marker label pill for linked shapes, unlinkObjectInfo, deleteInformation cascade.

Tests 3/3 green, typecheck + eslint clean.

Commit: a16efca (branch feature/248-shape-information-link)

issues.display_title: Issue #249: Pano-linked Information markers render a round thumbnail chip in preview
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Description

In preview/live, an Information record that has a linked panorama should render its map marker as a round image chip (the pano thumbnail in a circle) with the name label to the right — like classic indoor-map pano markers (see reference screenshot: Great Room / Leasing Office).

Today the marker visual comes only from labelType (resolveLabelRender in src/lib/map/objectLabel.ts): text dot, icon, logo, or photo — the linked pano (Information.pano, set by the Add Panorama import, #238) is never considered, so pano-bearing records still show as a plain text dot unless someone manually uploads a photo.

Scope

  • resolveLabelRender (or the marker renderer): when info.pano is set, render the round photo chip from info.pano.thumbnail
  • Precedence: an explicitly configured visual label (icon/logo/photo with a valid asset) still wins; the pano thumbnail replaces the plain-text fallback
  • The record's name/title renders to the right of the chip, always visible (like the text mode's dot+name row), not hover-only
  • Applies wherever MapObjectMarkers renders (preview, live, editor Map tab)
  • Broken/missing thumbnail degrades to the existing text fallback

Acceptance Criteria

  • Pano-linked Information markers show a round pano-thumbnail chip with the name to the right in preview/live
  • Explicit icon/logo/photo label types still take precedence over the pano thumbnail
  • Records without pano keep current behavior (text dot / icon / logo / photo)
  • Thumbnail load failure falls back to the text label (no broken image circle)
  • Far-zoom bare-dot collapse and declutter keep working

Dependencies

#238 (merged) — Information.pano

RESULT

Pano-linked Information markers now render the round thumbnail chip with the always-visible name at the right.

What changed:

  • src/lib/map/objectLabel.ts — new pano render mode; a linked Information.pano upgrades every plain-text fallback (unset labelType, or icon/logo/photo whose asset is missing) to { mode: "pano", src: pano.thumbnail }. Explicit visual labels with a valid asset still win.
  • src/components/editor/map-markers/MapObjectMarkers.tsx — pano mode renders a 28px round object-cover chip + name to the right (always visible); broken thumbnail hides the chip and leaves the name (text-look degrade); far-zoom bare dot uses bg-sky-500; thumbnails are loading="lazy" + decoding="async" so many pano markers don't block the main thread.
  • src/lib/map/__tests__/objectLabel.test.ts — 1 new test, 4 assertions (fallback upgrade + precedence).

Perf note: per-frame repositioning is unchanged (transform-only); thumbnails are the small TourMkr previews, downloaded once and HTTP-cached.

Tests 6/6 green, typecheck + eslint clean.

Commits: 04fdc7a, c1adc28 (branch feature/249-pano-thumbnail-marker)
